description: No credential or login required. List the Shinhan Bank account links this caller registered, each with the account_link_id and bank_account_credential_id the accounts and transaction history tools need. Reads our records only; shinhan_easy.accounts.list fetches live accounts from the bank. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 사업자 유형: 개인사업자 호출마다 토큰 1소진
